targetText: From all that has been said in this book on the economic essence of imperialism, it follows that we must define it as capitalism in transition, or, more precisely, as moribund capitalism.
summary: Imperialism represents decaying, moribund capitalism: the transitional epoch leading to socialist revolution.
context: Monopoly capitalism has socialized production, creating the administrative foundation for a planned economy.

summary: Massive corporate supply chains organize global production on a planned scale, building the technical foundation for socialism.
context: Capitalism creates large-scale planning mechanisms that society can take over for public benefit.

targetText: The most dangerous of all in this respect are those who do not wish to understand that the fight against imperialism is a sham and humbug unless it is inseparably bound up with the fight against opportunism.
summary: Anti-imperialist action is useless unless workers simultaneously struggle against reformist leaders who defend the system.
context: Political clarity and breaking with opportunist union leaders are necessary for genuine social change.
